correctness.rationale: Scaling by the common mean gives Gamma shape 1/v and scale v and inverse-Gaussian mean one and shape 1/v. The log density-ratio derivative is (-x²+(2+v)x−1)/(2vx²). It has two distinct positive zeros; thus Rolle's theorem bounds distinct ratio zeros by three. The signs at zero and infinity are opposite as claimed, from the inverse-Gaussian essential small-x decay and the faster Gamma exponential large-x decay. Matching mass, mean and second raw moment forces at least three density sign changes by integration against the sign-matching polynomial of degree at most two. Hence each crossing lies on a strict noncritical branch. The CDF difference is positive at the first and third density zeros and on the outer intervals; its integral is zero by the equal means, so it is negative at the middle density zero. Strict monotonicity gives the two and only two interior CDF zeros. For s=√v and z=(x−1)/s, Stirling/Taylor independently give first-order log density corrections s(z³−3z)/3 and s(z³−3z)/2. On |z|≤s^(−1/12), the log remainders are O(s²(1+|z|⁴)); exponentiating adds O(s²(1+|z|⁶)) times a Gaussian. To check the tail step, the two standardized log MGFs are −u/s−s^(−2)log(1−su) and −u/s+s^(−2)(1−√(1−2su)). Both are O(u²) for |su|≤1/4. Taking |u| a sufficiently small constant times s^(−1/12) gives superpolynomially small tails. Thus integrating gives s(z²−1)φ(z)/6+O(s²) on compact z-sets, with signs bracketing both ±1. Independently evaluated exact CDF formulas and bisection agree with the v=1 examples and illustrate the two limits; these diagnostics were not used to prove the uniform-in-parameter count.
residual_risks: Unshifted positive laws only; no asymptotic uniformity over all standardized times or empirical model validation.

value.rationale: These are established alternative residence-time models and mean/variance matching is a plausible choice when only two moments are known. The exact number, order and concentrated-regime location of deadline preference reversals is a useful distinction that the moments, an example plot, or vague nonordering do not provide. The exact statement is an independently useful parametric boundary, not a claim about which law fits a field site.
residual_risks: Practical relevance depends on application-specific fit and valid positive unshifted travel-time models.
